question: After the terminal-output defect is repaired, should transient progress metadata become a portable public plugin SDK contract or remain an internal bundled-plugin seam?
rationale: The line-level delivery repair is clear, but the permanent third-party API owner and vocabulary cannot be chosen safely without maintainer intent.

options.title: Portable public lifecycle API
options.body: Expose generic transient-progress metadata with explicit terminal-output exclusions and no provider-specific channel policy.

options.title: Internal bundled seam
options.body: Keep the typed signal private until external plugin demand demonstrates that a public contract is necessary.

options.title: Codex-specific public kind
options.body: Retain the proposed export and explicitly own provider-specific progress kinds as supported SDK surface.

recommendation.title: Portable public lifecycle API
recommendation.body: Expose generic transient-progress metadata with explicit terminal-output exclusions and no provider-specific channel policy.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest current-main history connects this owner to the verbose output policy and both affected runtime surfaces.
